bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: Chicago Bears head coach Ben Johnson said wide receiver Rome Odunze is "day-to-day" with an injury that is different from the foot issue he had a year ago and is putting his Week 1 status in jeopardy ahead of Sunday's season opener against the Carolina Panthers. That distinction is significant for Chicago, particularly with the team entering the season without DJ Moore after trading him to the Buffalo Bills, leaving Odunze expected to play a much larger role in Caleb Williams' passing game if he's able to suit up.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are gearing up for their Week 1 matchup against the New Orleans Saints, having named seven team captains ahead of the 2026 regular season and made several roster moves. Meanwhile, the team received an injury update indicating that prized free-agent center Cade Mays' debut with the Lions is going to have to wait several weeks, as he is reportedly eyeing a mid-October return from his broken wrist.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest story is that running back Josh Jacobs' Week 1 status is in flux, with reports noting Dales breaks down Packers' RB situation following Josh Jacobs being placed on Commissioner's Exempt List , prompting the team to lean on MarShawn Lloyd as a replacement option. Meanwhile, Green Bay named its 2026 team captains, with quarterback Jordan Love, tight end Tucker Kraft, linebacker Isaiah McDuffie and safety Xavier McKinney retaining their leadership roles as the Packers prepare to open the season against the Minnesota Vikings.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The biggest Vikings storyline right now is the countdown to their Week 1 showdown, as Minnesota prepares to open the 2026 season at home against the rival Green Bay Packers on Sunday, September 13, with Kyler Murray making his first regular-season start at quarterback for the Vikings. Minnesota began its third week of training camp practice with an announcement that Kyler Murray has emerged as the winner of its quarterback battle, and the Vikings now have a month to prepare for Murray's first regular-season start against the Green Bay Packers on September 13.
